definitions.explanation: To examine two or more things to identify similarities and differences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{比|くら}べてから⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。

examples.notes: と marks what is compared with what

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{比|くら}べて、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧。
examples.english: Compared to last year, this year is hot.
examples.notes: と{比|くら}べて = compared to

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: AとBを{比|くら}べる (compare A and B) / Xと{比|くら}べて (compared to X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {比|くら}べている = 'is comparing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・AとBを{比|くら}べる (compare A and B)
・〜と{比|くら}べて (compared to ~)
・〜に{比|くら}べて (compared to ~—same meaning)
・{比|くら}べ{物|もの}にならない (cannot be compared, incomparable)
・{比|くら}べてみる (try comparing)

GRAMMAR NOTE: Both と{比|くら}べて and に{比|くら}べて mean 'compared to' and are largely interchangeable.

RELATED:
・{比較|ひかく} (comparison—noun, more formal)
・{比較|ひかく}する (to compare—する verb, more formal)
